name: LocalPages

sources.title: Homepage — US local business directory ('find the best places to be'); 'Claim Your Business Listing For FREE' banner notes Yext partnership covering 40+ sites; claim route at /business-listing/add

requirements: Local-business fit — this is a US local citation directory (restaurants, hotels, services, shops); a pure SaaS/software product only fits if it operates as a local business with an address
Free claim requires signing up for an account (/signup) then using /business-listing/add
NAP data (name, address, phone) is the core listing content
preparation: Business name, address, phone, website, category
An email for the account signup
workflow: Search for an existing listing first — claim it if present, otherwise add a new one
Submit business details; expect a verification step typical of claim flows
watchFor: Yext partnership means upsells — claiming '40+ other sites' through Yext is a paid syndication service, not part of the free LocalPages listing
Homepage categories template renders placeholders ('{{x.title}}') — the site looks half-maintained
Only worthwhile if the company has a real US local presence; a remote SaaS with no address does not belong
An odd 'Shop' section and matrimony/services categories suggest a generic directory script — modest value
countsAsLive: The business appears in LocalPages search results for its city/category with a public profile page
unknowns: Verification method for claimed listings (phone/email/postcard — not shown publicly)
Whether edits propagate to the Yext network or stay local
